title: Remote device that causes defecation

tellings.quote: I know for example, someone that worked on a on a device that uh could make someone immediately have to defecate uncontrollably.

plain: A guest named Dave Rossi, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says he knows someone who worked on a device that could make a person suddenly and uncontrollably need to go to the toilet. He gives no place or date, but the story suggests secret work on strange weapons that act on the body from a distance.
